title: LOOK: India PM Narendra Modi arrives in PH for 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in the Philippines on Monday afternoon, November 16, 2026, to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrives in Manila, Philippines on November 16, 2026, to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit. Photo courtesy of ASEAN PH
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in the Philippines on Monday afternoon, November 16, 2026, to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
At the airport, Modi was welcomed by Department of Information and Communications Technology Secretary Robert Joseph de Claro.
Earlier Monday, other foreign leaders also arrived in the country for the summit, including those from South Korea, New Zealand and Japan.
The 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits are being held from November 16 to 18, following the opening ceremony on Sunday, November 15.
The Philippines is hosting this year's summit and is expected to turn over the ASEAN chairmanship to Singapore.— MCG, GMA News
